title: Normalized QuickGO Denominator Coverage
description: Validation contract for normalized denominator coverage accounting across the cohort accessions, binding catalog protein_id to technical QuickGO linkage and annotation status.

protein_id.description: Resolved catalog entity identifier from candidate v0.3.0 mfp_proteins.csv.

database_protein_id.description: Linked protein identifier from database table protein.id, or null if unlinked/absent.

quickgo_coverage_status.description: Technical database linkage and annotation presence status.

identity_review_status.description: Biological identity review classification orthogonal to database coverage.

stored_annotation_rows.description: Count of actual annotation rows in MFP_QuickV1.

distinct_go_terms.description: Count of distinct Gene Ontology term identifiers.

notes.description: Diagnostic and provenance notes explaining missingness or identity discrepancy.
